title: Exam Question
description: Schema for an individual exam question extracted from a university question paper, including classification, marks, and syllabus mapping.

paper_id.description: Identifier of the parent paper this question belongs to.

section.description: Section label within the paper (e.g. 'A', 'Section B').

question_number.description: Main question number as printed on the paper.

sub_question.description: Sub-question identifier — a letter or number (e.g. 'a', 'ii', '3').

word_limit.description: Word limit specified for the answer, if any.

has_internal_choice.description: Whether an OR/internal-choice alternative exists for this question.

choice_questions.description: List of alternative question IDs or inline question objects offered as internal choices.

topic.description: Primary syllabus topic this question maps to.

unit.description: Syllabus unit number or title this question belongs to.

page_reference.description: Page number in the source document where this question appears.

is_compulsory.description: Whether answering this question is compulsory.

special_instructions.description: Any special instructions attached to this question (e.g. 'draw neat diagram', 'use log tables').
